author: D. A. Milton
title: Sweet Grass County seeks applicants for 2026 election judge positions
text:
Sweet Grass County is seeking individuals to serve as election judges for upcoming elections. The county has announced that training sessions for new and returning election judges will be held, with dates available in an attached flyer.
Election judges play a key role in ensuring the integrity and smooth operation of polling places during elections. The county encourages interested residents to review the training schedule and consider participating in this civic duty.
More information about requirements and responsibilities can be found by contacting the Sweet Grass County election office.
